subject: Request: POC throughput headroom for weekend ramp
messages:
From: Diane Lee <diane.lee@fastretail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ops@fastretail.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: POC throughput headroom for weekend ramp

Hi Markus,

Quick note from the FastRetail engineering team — we’re planning a controlled weekend ramp to validate end-to-end latency and 99th percentile behavior for the checkout recommendation pipeline. The POC is scheduled to run Saturday night (beginning 2026-06-13 22:00 PT) for a 6 hour soak.

Our current trial allocation is likely to be exhausted during the peak. Can Redwood provide a temporary headroom buffer (approx. $1,200 equivalent / ~30k extra token units) for this window? We’ll provide regular telemetry and a short post-run summary.

Attached: poc-plan.pdf (application/pdf), telemetry-sample.csv (text/csv)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Diane
Diane Lee
Senior Engineering Manager, FastRetail
Diane.Lee@fastretail.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: POC throughput headroom for weekend ramp

Markus — forwarding FastRetail's ask.

Summary: external POC needs a short-term top-up for a 6h overnight soak (estimate ~30k tokens, ~$1.2k). They attached a short telemetry sample and a preflight plan.

Can we approve a one-time safety buffer from the promo pool? If yes, suggest we limit to Saturday 22:00–Sunday 04:00 PT and require telemetry upload + a follow-up call Monday morning.

Also: ops should verify the model variant and fallback policy (they're testing a 13B quantized variant).

Attachments: forwarded poc-plan.pdf

Ben

Redwood Inference

> Summary: external POC needs a short-term top-up for a 6h overnight soak (estimate ~30k tokens, ~$1.2k). They attached a short telemetry sample and a preflight plan.
> 
> Can we approve a one-time safety buffer from the promo pool? If yes, suggest we limit to Saturday 22:00–Sunday 04:00 PT and require telemetry upload + a follow-up call Monday morning.

Approved. Please proceed with a timeboxed credit window and log the authorization in the deal record. Conditions:
- Limit to the stated 6h window (2026-06-13 22:00 PT to 2026-06-14 04:00 PT).
- Cap at 35k token-equivalent to cover a 10–15% overrun.
- Require telemetry upload to shared Drive link and a short 30m post-mortem on Monday 06/15.

Ben/Camila — please coordinate operations and enable a temporary promo allowance on FR-POC-8793. Neha, flag any billing/procurement exceptions if the run exceeds the cap.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Diane Lee <diane.lee@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ops@fastretail.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: POC throughput headroom for weekend ramp

Thanks so much — really appreciate the quick approval and the cap. We ran the Saturday soak; initial numbers look promising (p95 under target, p99 within 10% of expectation). I uploaded the run telemetry and a short post-run note to the Drive link you shared.

Per the cap: we came in at ~28.5k token-equivalent, so under the 35k allowance. We’d like to schedule the 30m follow-up for Monday at 11:00 PT if that works for your ops and engineering leads.

Next steps on our side: share a short annotated trace, a config snapshot, and a list of remaining questions around model quantization tradeoffs.

Attaching: postrun-summary.pdf (application/pdf) — forwarding to the deal record as requested.

Best,
— Diane
